item.title: iPhone 17e to Use OLED Panel from iPhone 16e But With Slimmer Bezels
item.description: Apple's upcoming iPhone 17e will continue to use the OLED display panel that originated with the iPhone 14 and is also used for the current iPhone 16e, but will feature slimmer display bezels.Read More...
